title: Add Tabs
content: Create accessible tabbed interface component. Tab list with role="tablist", individual tabs with role="tab" aria-selected aria-controls. Tab panels with role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby. Style tabs: horizontal with border-b, active tab with border-b-2 border-blue-600 text-blue-600. Add hover states for inactive tabs. Implement keyboard navigation: arrow keys to move, Enter/Space to select. Support both controlled and uncontrolled modes. Add content transition animation (fade or slide). Variants: underline tabs, pill/button tabs, vertical tabs. Handle overflow with scroll or dropdown for many tabs. Lazy load tab content option for performance.

variants.simple: Create a tabbed interface with tab buttons and content panels.
variants.detailed: Create accessible tabbed interface component. Tab list with role="tablist", individual tabs with role="tab" aria-selected aria-controls. Tab panels with role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby. Style tabs: horizontal with border-b, active tab with border-b-2 border-blue-600 text-blue-600. Add hover states for inactive tabs. Implement keyboard navigation: arrow keys to move, Enter/Space to select. Support both controlled and uncontrolled modes. Add content transition animation (fade or slide). Variants: underline tabs, pill/button tabs, vertical tabs. Handle overflow with scroll or dropdown for many tabs. Lazy load tab content option for performance.
variants.advanced: Create accessible tabbed interface component with full keyboard support and variants. Component structure: Tabs container, TabList, Tab, TabPanels, TabPanel. TabList: role="tablist", flex with optional border-b. Tab button: role="tab", aria-selected={isActive}, aria-controls={panelId}, tabIndex={isActive ? 0 : -1}. TabPanel: role="tabpanel", aria-labelledby={tabId}, tabIndex={0}, hidden={!isActive}. Styling variants: 1) Underline: border-b-2 on TabList, active tab border-blue-600 -mb-px, 2) Pills: gap-2 no border, active tab bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 rounded-lg, 3) Boxed: border around tabs, active tab bg-white with top border, 4) Vertical: flex-col for TabList, TabPanels beside. Keyboard navigation: Left/Right arrows (or Up/Down for vertical) move focus between tabs, Home/End for first/last, Enter/Space activates focused tab. Implement roving tabindex: only active tab has tabIndex=0, others -1. Focus management: arrow key moves focus AND activates (auto-activation) or just moves focus (manual activation based on prop). Content transition: fade (opacity) or slide (translateX) animation on panel change, use key or conditional rendering. Controlled mode: activeIndex and onChange props. Uncontrolled mode: internal state with defaultIndex. Overflow handling: for many tabs, add horizontal scroll with fade edges, or "More" dropdown with hidden tabs. Lazy loading: render TabPanel children only when first activated, keep mounted after. Disabled tabs: aria-disabled, skip in keyboard navigation, grayed styling. Icons in tabs: support icon prop with proper spacing. ACCESSIBILITY: ensure panels are in DOM for screen readers even if visually hidden, or use proper hiding technique.
